input.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN y.total > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID) y
  ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
